newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamrock sees higher 1997 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Tamrock sees higher 1997 net profit.

text.p: Finnish mining equipment group Tamrock said on Tuesday it expected its net profit to rise this year although the profit before extraordinary items would be at last year's level.
"The net result is estimated to show an improvement on the previous year due to lower direct taxes and minority interest," it said in a statement with its first quarter earnings.

"The unfavourable development of the coal equipment business continues to have a negative impact on group profitability, but the 1997 result before extraordinary items, provisions and taxes is expected to stay at least on the 1996 level," it said.
Tamrock's Q1 profit before extraordinary items and tax fell to 27 million markka from 35 million in the year-ago period.

Under its former name Tampella, the company in full-year 1996 posted a 141 million markka profit before extraordinary items, and a net profit of 65 million. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, news@reuters.fi
